domains.label: Consistency & value judgments
domains.description: Choices that basic economics says should be consistent but often aren't -- like sticking with a bad deal because you already paid for it, or picking a guaranteed $1 million over a slightly-better bet. The dots show how often people made the "inconsistent" choice, real vs. simulated.
